summary: The RptMnuPositionUtilizationSummary is a web user control designed to facilitate the generation of position utilization reports. It integrates various components and workflows to allow users to specify parameters such as agency, department, program, and date range to produce a summary report in HTML and CSV formats.
purpose: To provide a user interface for generating and viewing position utilization summaries based on selected criteria.

workflows.name: Generate Position Utilization Report
steps: Page_PreRender event checks UserSession and prepares JavaScript variables.
ddPlcAgency_Change updates department and program dropdowns.
cmdExcel_Click executes report generation using parameters.
Output report as HTML and CSV on completion.

business_rules: FillAgencyDropdown only when there are no items in the dropdown.
FillDepartmentDropdown when the agency changes or when no items are present.
FillProgramDropdown when the department changes or when no items are present.
Use stored procedure 'ReportPosUtilSummary' for report generation.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for start and end date.
conditions: If UserSession is not null, proceed with report setup.
system_behavior: Registers JavaScript for client-side functionality based on postback type.
Binds data to dropdown lists based on user selection.
content_gaps: Some details regarding calculations or exceptions may be missing.
